source: Fueli recipe library, written for this app (Oct 2026). Every ingredient is priced by the nutrition database or is a pantry staple. Quantities are for one serving. recipes.name: Salmon quinoa bowl
steps: Pan-fry the salmon and flake it.
Serve over quinoa with spinach, avocado and soy sauce.

recipes.name: Veggie rice and bean burrito
steps: Warm the rice and beans.
Fill the tortilla with rice, beans, pepper, cheese and avocado and roll.

recipes.name: Pork with sweet potato mash
steps: Boil the sweet potato 15 minutes and mash with butter.
Sear the pork 4 minutes per side and serve with broccoli.

recipes.name: Chickpea tomato pasta
steps: Cook the pasta.
Simmer the tomatoes, garlic and chickpeas 8 minutes, add the spinach and toss with the pasta.

recipes.name: Shrimp and corn rice bowl
steps: Cook the shrimp 3 minutes.
Serve over rice with corn, avocado and lemon.

recipes.name: Egg and tomato curry
steps: Boil the eggs 9 minutes and peel.
Soften the onion with the spice, add the tomatoes and simmer 8 minutes, add the eggs and spinach.
Serve with rice.
